Speed wins buyer leads ⚡

1. Start with "Immediate (0–30 days)" buyers: call and email them the same day
2. Then the "1–3 months" group: send 3 listings that match their budget and area
3. Drip the rest, so you're the agent they remember when they're ready
4. Screen numbers against the DNC Registry and follow TCPA rules for calls and texts
